source: Registers matter for two opposite reasons. First, they are exactly where performance-sensitive values often should live: close to execution, without repeated traffic to larger memory. Second, the register file is finite and shared among all resident threads on an ZXNAME0000XZ. High per-thread register use can therefore reduce how many blocks and warps fit concurrently.[1,2]
zh: 寄存器的重要性有两个相反的原因。首先，它们正是性能敏感值通常应该存在的地方：接近执行，而不需要重复传输到更大的内存。其次，寄存器文件是有限的，并且在 ZXNAME0000XZ 上的所有常驻线程之间共享。因此，每线程寄存器的高使用量可以减少同时适合的块和扭曲数量。[1,2]
